title: Father told him that story
html_source:
John Joyce to his son James, 1931:

I wonder do you recollect the old days in Brighton Square, when you were Babie Tuckoo, and I used to take you out in the Square and tell you all about the moo-cow that used to come down from the mountain and take little boys across?

anchor.prefix:
